label: SINCERE_SEEKING_2: Honest inquiry or desire for relationship
definition: Honest inquiry or desire for relationship. Seeking is neither a necessary condition for nonresistance (someone may never have had the concept) nor alone sufficient to prove the absence of every resistance causing nonbelief. No theorem turns a self-report of sincere seeking into the empirical existential.
